title: Quietly Quintessential Peruvian Olive Tiradito
description: A light and festive Peruvian dish featuring pitted black olives in a soffritto-base, served in a copper mug. This low-calorie-friendly tiradito is perfect for a snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger and blend until well combined.
Heat olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat and add the blended onion mixture, cooking until softened.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Arrange sliced black olives in the bottom of a copper mug.
Spoon the onion mixture over the olives, making sure to cover them completely.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve cold, straight from the copper mug.
